Ungated ROOT/audit.py fails at fresh index 3 by design (ambiguity refusal). See ungated-official-protocol-85fa5666.json. Certification must use the gated audit (host-audit.json) and a dispatched evidence gate.

Builder capacity: build_million tries 50 context draws per fixed query. For the rare obstacle-geometry queries (about 0.7%), a demo set holds evidence with p about 2.2% per draw, so about 33% of those queries will be rejected as missing evidence. That is roughly 0.25% of queries: a small, reported bias, not a correctness issue. Raising context attempts for this task would remove it.
Hypothesis family is finite. Other exotic stop rules cannot be excluded in principle. Natural alternatives (any-touch stop, ring-touch stop) are refuted by fixture pair 1 cells (4,10),(5,11).
Without dispatch, ambiguous raw episodes still fail safely in verify() (the program raises), so there is no false label, but they are lost as TargetErrors instead of being resampled.
